name: NuMECS
full_name: Neutrino Mass via Electron Capture Spectroscopy
summary: NuMECS is a US calorimetric development programme for determining neutrino mass from the electron-capture spectrum of holmium-163. It demonstrated isotope production, purification, incorporation and spectroscopy; its prototype spectrum is not a sub-eV mass measurement.
detection_principle: Holmium is enclosed in a gold absorber coupled to a superconducting transition-edge sensor. The calorimeter measures atomic de-excitation energy while the neutrino escapes; endpoint distortions can constrain its effective mass.

status.evidence: A 40-hour prototype measurement recorded the holmium-163 spectrum at approximately 0.1 Bq. This source establishes historical R&D, rather than continuous operation in 2026.
